import com.esotericsoftware.kryo.io.{Input, Output}

import java.io.{ByteArrayInputStream, ByteArrayOutputStream}

val kryo = new Kryo()
kryo.register(classOf[FloatGeoTiffTile])

val serializer = new GeoTiffTileSerializer[Float]()
val bos = new ByteArrayOutputStream()
val output = new Output(bos)

// Create a dummy tile to serialize then deserialize
val dummyTile = new FloatGeoTiffTile(10, 10, 0, 0, 10, 10, Array.fill(100)(1.0f))
serializer.write(kryo, output, dummyTile)
output.flush()

val bis = new ByteArrayInputStream(bos.toByteArray)
val input = new Input(bis)

val deserializedTile = serializer.read(kryo, input, classOf[FloatGeoTiffTile])

val witness = deserializedTile.getWidth * deserializedTile.getHeight
assert(witness == 100, s"Expected 100 pixels, got $witness")
assert(deserializedTile.getData()(0) == 1.0f, "Data mismatch after deserialization")

import org.apache.spark.rdd.RDD

// Extract a sample feature to initialize the iterator
val feature: IFeature = featuresRDD.first()
val rasterMetadata = rasterRDD.metadata
val pixelsInside = new PixelsInside(feature.getGeometry, rasterMetadata)

var lastCoord: (Int, Int, Int) = (0, 0, 0)

  val nextPixel = pixelsInside.next()
  lastCoord = nextPixel
  count += 1
}

val withinBounds = x >= 0 && x < rasterMetadata.width && y >= 0 && y < rasterMetadata.height

assert(if (count > 0) withinBounds else true, "Pixel coordinates must be within raster dimensions")
